title: NGS pipelines for Illumina data: full commands
description: Complete command lines, repositories and server notes for the secondary and tertiary analysis of Illumina sequencing data (trimming, quality control, alignment, assembly, variant calling, annotation, expression, pathways, association, miRNA, methylation), companion to the paper 'High-performance processing of Illumina sequencing data: Galaxy pipelines, tools and parallelisation on an ARM-GPU server' (Annual of Assen Zlatarov University, Burgas, 2026). Options were checked on an aarch64 Galaxy server.
